measures.label: Commits
measures.definition: Commits in the 12 months up to the last one.

measures.label: Contributors
measures.definition: People who made a commit in those 12 months; bots are left out.

measures.label: New contributors
measures.definition: Of them, those whose first commit to the project was in those 12 months.

measures.label: Half the commits by
measures.definition: The fewest people whose commits add up to half of those 12 months': how far the work is spread.

measures.label: Organizations
measures.definition: Organizations whose addresses committed in those 12 months, by email domain; a domain only one person uses is not one.

measures.label: AI-assisted
measures.definition: The share of the last four quarters' commits that name an AI coding assistant; a lower bound.
